# Ulv trophy

Type: Trophy | Internal ID: TrophyUlv | Source: Ulv | Usage: Decoration | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

The Ulv trophy is a rare drop from Ulvs inside Frost Caves in the Mountains.

### Misc

• Can be displayed in an Item Stand.
• Can be used to program the Ballista.

Categorias: Trophies, Materials
